people.name: sGangs ru tshul khrims rgyal mtshan

relations.subject: sLob dpon bsTan 'dzin rnam dag
relations.object: sGangs ru tshul khrims rgyal mtshan
relations.evidence: From 1945 to 1950, he lived as a virtual hermit under the guidance of his master sGangs ru tshul khrims rgyal mtshan.

relations.subject: sLob dpon bsTan 'dzin rnam dag
relations.evidence: In 1950, he went to sMan ri gling to study and in 1953 received his lha rams pa degree.

relations.subject: sLob dpon bsTan 'dzin rnam dag
relations.evidence: From 1961 until 1964, he lived and worked in the United Kingdom with the Tibetologist David Snellgrove.

relations.subject: sLob dpon bsTan 'dzin rnam dag
relations.evidence: In 1986 he established his own dgon pa in the Kathmandu valley, Khri brtan nor bu rtse.

relations.subject: sLob dpon bsTan 'dzin rnam dag
relations.evidence: It was at the time of the bDud rtsi 'bum sgrub that sLob dpon bstan 'dzin rnam dag received teachings at the monastery from Shes rab bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan.
